title: Send your coin’s fees to anyone you pick
blurb: Send your coin’s fees to anyone you pick.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
Every coin earns trading fees. On Maxpad, you decide where they go.

A TikToker. A streamer. A Reddit user. Your holders. They don’t sign up for anything. Their share just shows up.

Set it once

Pick who gets paid, give each a share, launch. Every trade after that pays out the same way.

The split is locked at launch. Nobody can change it, us included.

Pay anyone

A tip pops up on stream. A gift lands on a TikTok. Gold lands on a Reddit post. Paid on the app they already use.

Or send SOL to a wallet, reward your holders, buy back and burn, or give to charity.

They sign up for nothing

Their share waits in a vault tied to their handle. They prove the handle is theirs, and they take the money. As SOL, or the way that site already pays them.

15% runs the payouts. The other 85% goes exactly where you said.

Your coin. Your fees. Your call.

Launch one on maxpad.io

Who are you sending yours to? Tell me below.
